exact_nonroutine_external_premises: Let M be a complex manifold, L a holomorphic line bundle with a smooth Hermitian metric, and s a holomorphic section not identically zero on any connected component. Set dd^c=(i/(2 pi))partial barpartial and define the curvature eta locally by eta=-dd^c log|e|^2 for a nonvanishing holomorphic frame e with its metric norm. Then log|s|^2 is locally integrable and dd^c log|s|^2=[div(s)]-eta as currents, where [div(s)] is the positive integration current of the zero divisor, including its vanishing multiplicities. This holds also when that divisor is singular.

primary_sources.application: Locally write s=g e: log|s|^2=log|g|^2+log|e|^2. Demailly i/pi partial barpartial log|g| equals our i/(2pi) partial barpartial log|g|^2. The frame metric contributes -eta. Nonzero sections pulled back by a surjective modification remain nontrivial holomorphic germs, hence locally integrable, with positive total transform divisor current.

primary_source_audit.task_given_premise: The closed-nef compact-Kahler order theorem is explicitly given in the FrozenTask; the optional arbitrary-Kahler-modification extension reduces to it. The quantitative product theorem does not use it. No new Monge-Ampere existence theorem is imported.

source_report.report: The exact premise is established by [Demailly, III.2.15 and V.13.2–13.3](https://people.math.harvard.edu/~demarco/Math274/Demailly_ComplexAnalyticDiffGeom.pdf). Dividing the section formula by 2π gives the stated normalization and curvature sign. Local integrability follows in a holomorphic frame; holomorphic vanishing multiplicities are nonnegative, and singular divisors are explicitly included. The formula applies to the note’s fixed metrics, nonnegative real sums, and pulled-back nonzero sections. This verifies the external premise without establishing the referenced n1/n2 arguments.

root_math_assessment: Distributional Gauduchon integration against a global locally integrable logarithmic potential compares the full infimum, not a restricted test family. A closed constant-rank comparison form gives quantitative power bounds. Explicit projective incidence geometry and exceptional-divisor Poincare-Lelong prove the fixed positive-function cone formula. Pullbacks of nonzero sections supply genuine positive total transforms. Effective real divisor coefficients and cone-preserving sufficient parameter conditions give nonnegative blockwise rank gaps and exact equality. All integer jumps 1 through m-1 are realized by genuinely nonclosed examples. Optional arbitrary-Kahler-source modifications use only the closed-nef order theorem expressly given in P02, without claiming two-sided bounds from that premise alone.
root_editorial_expansion: The exact q-section degree proof is expanded from the complete blind n3 reconstruction. Residual parameter conditions are stated as sufficient, and actual nonclosedness requires a nonzero fixed-generator derivative. The final scope is shortened without changing any theorem.
